video:video.video:title: Changing Lives With Bariatric Surgery
video:video.video:description: Calling our Plano, TX, practice to explore bariatric surgery could be a small first step on a truly transformative journey. Our bariatric procedures can provide lasting weight loss to people who think they’ve exhausted all their options. With nationally rated doctors, leading techniques in minimally invasive surgery, a reputation for committed patient care, and Marty, our very own office corgi, Texas Center for Bariatrics & Advanced Surgery is an excellent choice for your care.

video:video.video:title: What to Expect on the Day of Your Surgery
video:video.video:description: On the day of your procedure, you’ll arrive at one of the hospitals coordinating with Texas Center for Bariatrics & Advanced Surgery to be prepared and greeted by your surgeon and anesthesiologist. After surgery, you’ll be taken to a recovery room for time with your family and one-on-one care with a nurse. The next morning, you’ll be met again by your surgeon, your dietitian, and a bariatric care coordinator who will provide post-op instructions you can review before it’s time to head home the following day.

video:video.video:title: Take a Tour of Our Bariatrics Office in Plano
video:video.video:description: Our bariatrics facility in Plano, TX, is equipped with everything patients need to find success through surgical weight loss treatment. We’re proud to showcase dozens of happy patients’ before and after photos on our walls. Book your consultation to meet our board-certified surgeons and Marty, our office corgi and junior medical assistant.

video:video.video:title: Bariatric Revision Surgery Gives You a Fresh Start
video:video.video:description: Don’t lose hope if your first bariatric surgery didn’t produce the results you wanted. The Texas Center for Bariatrics & Advanced Surgery offers a fresh start through bariatric revision surgery in Plano, TX. Our board-certified surgeons use laparoscopic techniques to revise gastric sleeve gastric bypass, LAP-BAND®, and more.

video:video.video:title: A Look at Our Popular Bariatric Surgeries
video:video.video:description: Texas Center for Bariatrics & Advanced Surgery primarily offers LAP-BAND®, gastric sleeve, gastric bypass, SADI-S, and duodenal switch as surgical weight loss methods. These bariatric surgeries affect your digestive process differently, making each one suited to different needs. Request a consultation with our board-certified bariatric surgeons to find out which may be right for you.

video:video.video:title: A Leading Texas Bariatrics Practice
video:video.video:description: Texas Center for Bariatrics & Advanced Surgery is a world-class surgical weight loss practice serving the Dallas–Fort Worth area from Plano, TX. Our board-certified surgeons, Joe Cribbins and Edmund Chen, have offered ultra minimally invasive weight loss surgery using Da Vinci robotic technology since 2012. Our bariatric surgery practice is proud to deliver life-changing care to patients from 13 to 85 with procedures like gastric sleeve, gastric bypass, and bariatric revision surgery.

video:video.video:title: Getting Rid of Heartburn With Hiatal Hernia Surgery
video:video.video:description: Our Plano, TX, surgeons can treat heartburn and other potential effects of a hiatal hernia through laparoscopic surgery either performed on its own or at the same time as a bariatric procedure. Solutions include reflux repair and gallbladder removal. Let’s get to work on a custom plan.

video:video.video:title: Your Journey Starts With One Call
video:video.video:description: At Texas Center for Bariatrics & Advanced Surgery, your journey to better health, a slimmer figure, and greater confidence begins with reaching out to us, either online or by phone. Our team in Plano, TX, will get back to you soon to arrange a consultation with one of our board-certified bariatric surgeons. You’ll discuss your goals with Dr. Cribbins or Dr. Chen, and they’ll develop a surgical treatment plan based on this conversation.

video:video.video:title: Why We Practice Exclusively With da Vinci Xi
video:video.video:description: The da Vinci Xi® surgical system is a robotic technology that has revolutionized bariatric surgery, which is why Dr. Joseph Cribbins never operates without it. As Dr. Cribbins explains, da Vinci surgery is quicker, more accurate, less invasive, and leads to easier patient recoveries than traditional surgical methods. Our board-certified surgeons in Plano, TX, are experts in this tool.

video:video.video:title: Getting to Know Dr. Joe Cribbins
video:video.video:description: Meet Dr. Joe Cribbins, a board-certified bariatric surgeon with more than 20 years of experience serving patients in Plano, TX, and the greater DFW area. When Dr. Cribbins was completing his residency at Northwestern Memorial Hospital in Chicago, he was trained in gastric bypass surgery and realized the potential bariatric surgery has to change people’s lives. Our surgeon can help you realize your goals if you’ve been struggling to lose weight through traditional means.
